create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue object to track a rolling window of values with median and global average
create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to track and log training metrics like loss and accuracy over iterations
run_init_distributed_mode: run init_distributed_mode to set up PyTorch distributed training from environment variables
run_replace_batchnorm: run replace_batchnorm on a neural network to fuse and remove BatchNorm2d layers for inference
run_replace_layernorm: run replace_layernorm on a neural network to replace LayerNorm with Apex FusedLayerNorm for speed
